snippet.title: Neighborhoods - Official Reveal Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Reveal Trailer for Neighborhoods, a life-simulation city management game developed by E-Line Media. Players will facilitate a cozy city to ensure communities thrive, address common problems of a bustling town, and ensure residents are happy. Neighborhoods is coming soon to PC (Steam).
